saints.name: St. Rose Philippine Duchesne
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The French missionary of the Sacred Heart who carried Catholic education to the American frontier…
biography: Born at Grenoble in 1769, Rose Philippine Duchesne joined the Society of the Sacred Heart under its foundress St. Madeleine Sophie Barat, longing all the while to be a missionary. In 1818 she sailed to America and, on the Missouri frontier, opened at St. Charles the first free school west of the Mississippi.

For decades she founded schools, convents, and orphanages amid great hardship. Late in life she went to live among the Potawatomi, who, seeing her constant prayer, called her the woman who prays always. She died at St. Charles in 1852. Canonized in 1988, she is honoured in the United States on this day.
saints.knownFor: Pioneering Catholic education on the American frontier.
